blocks.zh: 操作考量：無菌干預、機械故障與環境監測 (8.4–8.9)
blocks.en: Operational Considerations: Aseptic Interventions, Mechanical Failures, and Environmental Monitoring (8.4–8.9)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握充填針損壞時的三種處置選項，以及預組裝流體路徑如何降低更換風險
blocks.en: Understand the three response options when a filling needle is damaged, and how a pre-assembled fluid path lowers the risk of replacement

blocks.zh: 理解破損或堵塞初級包裝材料的無菌干預原則，包括 AVS 與 APS 的設計要求
blocks.en: Understand the principles for aseptic interventions on broken or blocked primary packaging materials, including the AVS and APS design requirements

blocks.zh: 區分元件自動傳遞與手動傳遞的微生物風險差異，以及各層次包裝去除的標準
blocks.en: Distinguish the microbial risk of automated versus manual component transfer, and the criteria for removing each packaging layer

blocks.zh: 了解分選系統的滅菌、生物去污與矽油殘留等管理要點
blocks.en: Understand the key management points for sorting systems: sterilization, biodecontamination, and residual silicone oil

blocks.zh: 掌握機械干預四大分類及其相應的風險管理原則，理解何時必須停止批次
blocks.en: Understand the four categories of mechanical intervention, the risk management principles for each, and when a batch must be stopped

blocks.zh: 理解環境監測 (EM) 的事件驅動與時間驅動設計，以及樣品全生命週期管控的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the event-driven and time-driven design of environmental monitoring (EM), and the importance of controlling the full life cycle of EM samples

blocks.zh: 8.4 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Filling Needle Adjustment, Repair, and Replacement 8.4 充填針調整、修復與更換相關無菌操作之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.4 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Filling Needle Adjustment, Repair, and Replacement

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 充填針損壞的三選項決策：
blocks.en: Decision among three options for a damaged filling needle:

blocks.zh: 關閉針頭 (Turn off)：透過控制系統完成，無需進入 Grade A，零微生物風險。這是首選。
blocks.en: Turn off the needle: done through the control system, with no entry into Grade A and therefore zero microbial risk. This is the preferred option.

blocks.zh: 修復／調整 (Repair/Adjust)：需要無菌干預，必須符合 Section 8.2 一般干預原則，風險中等。
blocks.en: Repair/Adjust: requires an aseptic intervention that must comply with the general intervention principles in Section 8.2; moderate risk.

blocks.zh: 更換針頭 (Replace)：液體充填中最高風險干預之一——針頭正好位於開放患者劑量容器正上方，直接暴露無菌空間。
blocks.en: Replace the needle: one of the highest-risk interventions in liquid filling, because the needle sits directly above the open containers holding the patient dose and exposes the sterile space directly.

blocks.zh: 粉末充填的粉末劑量針 (powder dosing-needle) 無法關閉或修復，只能完全更換，管理難度更高。
blocks.en: A powder dosing needle cannot be turned off or repaired and can only be replaced completely, which makes it harder to manage.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像外科醫生在開胸手術進行中途需要更換手術刀：直接換一把刀（更換單一元件）vs. 換整組無菌手術包（預組裝流體路徑）。後者雖然動作較大，但接頭都已預先確認，減少現場失誤的機率。充填針的預組裝流體路徑就是這個邏輯——預先組裝、預先驗證，臨場更換時風險更低。
blocks.en: Imagine a surgeon who must change the scalpel in the middle of open-chest surgery: swapping a single blade (replacing one component) versus swapping in a whole sterile instrument pack (a pre-assembled fluid path). The latter involves a bigger move, but every connection has been confirmed in advance, which reduces the chance of errors on the spot. The pre-assembled fluid path for a filling needle follows the same logic: assembled and verified beforehand, so the risk is lower when it is replaced during the run.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 更換時的關鍵判斷：設計更換干預程序時，必須同時考量是否連同部分無菌流體路徑一起更換。單獨更換一個元件可能導致：
blocks.en: Key judgment when replacing: when designing the replacement intervention procedure, you must also consider whether part of the sterile fluid path should be replaced together with the needle. Replacing a single component alone may lead to:

blocks.zh: 接頭不當造成漏液或滴液
blocks.en: Improper connections causing leaks or dripping

blocks.zh: 流體路徑更長時間暴露於環境
blocks.en: Longer exposure of the fluid path to the environment

blocks.zh: 預組裝路徑雖然表面上「換的更多」，但整體無菌保證反而更高。決策原則：無菌保證 > 操作便利性。
blocks.en: Although a pre-assembled path appears to involve "replacing more", overall sterility assurance is actually higher. Decision principle: sterility assurance > operational convenience.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一支充填針在生產中途彎曲但未斷裂，你的操作員建議直接就地調整。在允許此干預之前，你需要確認哪些前提條件？
blocks.en: A filling needle bends but does not break in the middle of production, and your operator suggests adjusting it in place. What preconditions must you confirm before allowing this intervention?

blocks.zh: 為何粉末充填針的管理比液體充填針更具挑戰性？從 APS 設計的角度說明。
blocks.en: Why is managing a powder filling needle more challenging than managing a liquid filling needle? Explain from the perspective of APS design.

blocks.zh: 8.5 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Related to Broken or Blocked Primary-Packaging Materials 8.5 初級包裝材料破損或阻塞相關無菌操作之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.5 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Related to Broken or Blocked Primary-Packaging Materials

blocks.zh: 矯正性干預 (Corrective Intervention)：指在生產過程中，為應對突發狀況（如容器破裂、堵塞）而執行的無菌操作。與預防性干預不同，矯正性干預的特性是：
blocks.en: Corrective Intervention: an aseptic manipulation performed during production in response to an unplanned event (such as a broken or blocked container). Unlike a preventive intervention, a corrective intervention has these characteristics:

blocks.zh: 必須預先納入 AVS（Airflow Visualization Study，氣流可視化研究），驗證干預不造成氣流紊亂
blocks.en: It must be included in advance in the AVS (Airflow Visualization Study) to verify that the intervention does not disturb the airflow

blocks.zh: 必須納入 APS（Aseptic Process Simulation，無菌製程模擬），以代表性頻率演練
blocks.en: It must be included in the APS (Aseptic Process Simulation) and rehearsed at a representative frequency

blocks.zh: 必須納入 CCS（污染控制策略），作為正式管控措施
blocks.en: It must be included in the CCS (contamination control strategy) as a formal control measure

blocks.zh: 想像消防員在受控建築火災演習中：演習設計要模擬真實火災的發生頻率與位置，不能只練「最簡單的狀況」。無菌充填的 APS 設計也是同樣道理——破損容器的模擬頻率，必須反映實際生產中的發生率，而非象徵性地演練一次。
blocks.en: Think of firefighters in a controlled building-fire drill: the drill must simulate the real frequency and location of fires and cannot rehearse only the "easiest scenario". The same applies to APS design for aseptic filling: the simulation frequency for broken containers must reflect the actual occurrence rate in production, not be a token one-time rehearsal.

blocks.zh: 「最小化行動原則」是關鍵：
blocks.en: The "minimize actions" principle is the key:

blocks.zh: 干預時間越短，微生物污染風險越低
blocks.en: The shorter the intervention, the lower the risk of microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 掉落到機台底部的碎片，除非造成機台故障風險，否則應留到批次結束再處理——這是刻意設計的風險判斷，不是疏失
blocks.en: Fragments that fall to the bottom of the machine should be left until the end of the batch unless they pose a risk of machine malfunction. This is a deliberate risk-based judgment, not an oversight

blocks.zh: 工作高度以下的動作應避免——低於工作面的操作更難維持無菌技術，且容易干擾層流氣流
blocks.en: Movements below working height should be avoided, because aseptic technique is harder to maintain below the working surface and such movements easily disturb the unidirectional airflow

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：每一秒在 Grade A 的「額外動作」都是風險，能不做就不做。
blocks.en: Core logic: every "extra movement" in Grade A is a risk; if it can be avoided, avoid it.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，處理破損容器的 SOP 應包含：預先放置滅菌鑷子的位置清單、APS 演練頻率規劃（參考歷史破損率），以及 CCS 中的干預風險評估章節。監管機構查核時，常要求確認 APS 的干預場景是否充分代表實際生產。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the SOP for handling broken containers should include a list of positions for pre-placed sterile forceps, an APS rehearsal frequency plan (referencing historical breakage rates), and a section on intervention risk assessment in the CCS. During inspections, regulators often ask for confirmation that the APS intervention scenarios adequately represent actual production.

blocks.zh: 8.6 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Supply of Components 8.6 元件供應相關無菌操作之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.6 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Supply of Components

blocks.zh: 元件傳遞的技術層級（由低風險到高風險）：
blocks.en: Component transfer technologies (from lowest to highest risk):

blocks.zh: No-touch transfer (無接觸傳遞)：全自動，最低風險
blocks.en: No-touch transfer: fully automated, lowest risk

blocks.zh: RTP (Rapid Transfer Port，快速傳遞口)：密封對接傳遞，可防止 Grade B 空氣進入 Grade A
blocks.en: RTP (Rapid Transfer Port): sealed docking transfer that prevents Grade B air from entering Grade A

blocks.zh: Depyrogenation tunnel (去熱原隧道)：適用玻璃瓶等耐高溫材料
blocks.en: Depyrogenation tunnel: suitable for heat-resistant materials such as glass vials

blocks.zh: E-beam：電子束滅菌，適用塑膠容器
blocks.en: E-beam: electron-beam sterilization, suitable for plastic containers

blocks.zh: Mousehole 手動傳遞：最高風險，需 AVS 驗證不造成氣流逆向
blocks.en: Manual transfer through a mousehole: highest risk; AVS must demonstrate that no reverse airflow is created

blocks.zh: 自動化系統的三大優勢：可重複性 (repeatable)、可生物去污 (biodecontaminated)、可驗證 (validated)。
blocks.en: The three main advantages of automated systems: repeatable, biodecontaminated, and validated.

blocks.zh: 手動傳遞元件的「逐層去袋」原則，就像剝橙子：每進入一個更潔淨的區域，去掉一層皮，但必須確保去皮過程中不污染裡面那層。最內層只能在 Grade A 環境（最潔淨的地方）才能打開。如果在 Grade B 就剝開最內層，等於把「保護外皮」帶入了清潔室，反而污染內容物表面。
blocks.en: The "layer-by-layer bag removal" principle for manually transferred components is like peeling an orange: each time you enter a cleaner area you remove one layer of skin, but you must make sure that peeling does not contaminate the layer underneath. The innermost layer may be opened only in the Grade A environment (the cleanest place). If the innermost layer is opened in Grade B, the "protective outer skin" is effectively brought into the cleanroom and contaminates the surface of the contents.

blocks.zh: Mousehole 與 RTP 的 AVS 驗證要求：監管機構特別關注這個環節。使用 Mousehole 或門傳遞時，AVS 必須證明：
blocks.en: AVS requirements for mouseholes and RTPs: regulators pay particular attention to this area. When a mousehole or door transfer is used, the AVS must demonstrate that:

blocks.zh: 屏障內部不產生氣流紊亂 (no turbulence inside barrier)
blocks.en: No turbulence is generated inside the barrier

blocks.zh: 沒有空氣從 Grade B 進入 Grade A (no ingress from B to A)
blocks.en: There is no ingress of air from Grade B into Grade A

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 明確要求傳遞過程的氣流動態研究必須記錄在案，且 APS 必須以代表性頻率模擬補料過程。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 explicitly requires that airflow pattern studies of the transfer process be documented, and that the APS simulate the replenishment process at a representative frequency.

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶的產品使用矽化橡皮塞，目前採用 Mousehole 手動補料。你會建議升級到 RTP 或自動化系統嗎？需要哪些資料支持這個決策？
blocks.en: A CDMO client's product uses siliconized rubber stoppers, and stoppers are currently replenished manually through a mousehole. Would you recommend upgrading to an RTP or an automated system? What data would you need to support this decision?

blocks.zh: 手動傳遞時，「最後一層袋子必須在 Grade A 才能去除」的理由是什麼？如果在 Grade B 去除會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: For manual transfer, what is the rationale for removing the last bag layer only in Grade A? What risk arises if it is removed in Grade B?

blocks.zh: 8.7 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Sorting Systems for Components 8.7 元件分類系統相關無菌操作之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.7 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Associated with Sorting Systems for Components

blocks.zh: 分選系統 (Sorting System) 的特殊性：分選系統（如振動碗、進料碗）是客製化加工品，每套之間存在細微幾何差異。因此：
blocks.en: What makes sorting systems special: sorting systems (such as vibratory bowls and feed bowls) are custom-fabricated items, and there are subtle geometric differences between sets. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 每套 stoppering-set 必須個別定性 (characterize) 並確效 (qualify)
blocks.en: Each stoppering set must be individually characterized and qualified

blocks.zh: 使用 Kitting 程序或 ID 編號確保配套零件始終一起使用，避免混用導致效能差異
blocks.en: Use a kitting procedure or ID numbers to ensure that matched parts are always used together, so that mixing does not cause performance differences

blocks.zh: 批次開始前的設定調整應盡量完成，減少填充中途的無菌干預需求
blocks.en: Setup adjustments should be completed before the start of the batch as far as possible, to reduce the need for aseptic interventions during filling

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：設定優化優先於生產中調整，因為生產中調整 = 無菌干預 = 風險。
blocks.en: Key principle: setup optimization takes priority over adjustment during production, because adjustment during production = aseptic intervention = risk.

blocks.zh: 隔離器中分選系統的防護帽管理，就像賽車手的安全帽裝備：「先戴上帽子進賽車（先保護無菌內表面），等進入安全的密閉環境後再取下防護面罩（生物去污後再移除防護帽）」。兩種方式（去污前移除 vs. 去污後移除）各有支持者，關鍵是必須透過風險評估說明哪種方式在你的設施中更有效，並納入 CCS 書面化。
blocks.en: Managing protective caps on a sorting system in an isolator is like a racing driver's helmet routine: "put the cap on before entering the car (protect the sterile inner surfaces first), then remove the protective visor once inside the safe enclosed environment (remove the cap after biodecontamination)". Each approach (removal before decontamination vs. after decontamination) has its supporters; the key is to use a risk assessment to justify which is more effective in your facility, and to document it in the CCS.

blocks.zh: 矽油殘留 (Residual Silicone Oil) — 常被忽略的風險：
blocks.en: Residual Silicone Oil: a frequently overlooked risk:

blocks.zh: 矽化橡皮塞（siliconized stoppers）在分選碗中運行後，會在內表面留下矽油。矽油是一種疏水性物質，可以：
blocks.en: After siliconized stoppers run through a sorting bowl, silicone oil is left on the inner surfaces. Silicone oil is hydrophobic and can:

blocks.zh: 阻擋氣態過氧化氫 (VHP) 或其他生物去污劑接觸表面
blocks.en: Block vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP) or other biodecontamination agents from contacting the surface

blocks.zh: 顯著降低生物去污效果，使孢子殺滅數據 (sporicidal log reduction) 不達標
blocks.en: Significantly reduce biodecontamination efficacy, so that sporicidal log reduction data fall short of the target

blocks.zh: 因此清潔步驟必須包含矽油去除的確認，且應在滅菌前完成。這是 FDA 483 觀察常見項目之一。
blocks.en: The cleaning step must therefore include confirmation that silicone oil has been removed, and this must be completed before sterilization. This is one of the common FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用隔離器，分選碗目前的做法是「在生物去污前移除防護帽」。如果審計員詢問這個選擇的依據，你如何回答？需要準備哪些文件？
blocks.en: Your facility uses an isolator, and the current practice for the sorting bowl is to "remove the protective cap before biodecontamination". If an auditor asks for the rationale for this choice, how would you answer? What documents would you need to prepare?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Kitting 程序對分選系統特別重要？如果不同批次混用了不同套的零件，可能發生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is a kitting procedure especially important for sorting systems? What problems could occur if parts from different sets are mixed across batches?

blocks.zh: 8.8 Microbiological Considerations for Mechanical Interventions 8.8 機械介入之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.8 Microbiological Considerations for Mechanical Interventions

blocks.zh: 這四類就像醫院手術室的緊急情況分級：
blocks.en: These four categories are like the emergency triage levels in a hospital operating room:

blocks.zh: 類別 1：備用無菌手術器械已就緒，直接更換，有標準流程
blocks.en: Category 1: backup sterile instruments are ready and can be swapped in directly, with a standard procedure

blocks.zh: 類別 2：需要一個沒有預先備好的工具——必須緊急召開會議決定是否繼續
blocks.en: Category 2: a tool is needed that has not been prepared in advance, so an urgent meeting must decide whether to continue

blocks.zh: 類別 3：要碰到消毒時沒有照到的角落——需要個案評估
blocks.en: Category 3: reaching a corner that was missed during disinfection requires case-by-case evaluation

blocks.zh: 類別 4：需要打開手術室的牆壁維修管線——手術必須暫停，病人先轉移
blocks.en: Category 4: the operating room wall must be opened to repair piping, so the surgery must be paused and the patient moved out first

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Category 4 的嚴重後果
blocks.en: Key Notes: Severe Consequences of Category 4

blocks.zh: 技術區域（Gray Zone）開啟是無菌充填中最嚴重的中斷事件：
blocks.en: Opening a technical area (Gray Zone) is the most serious interruption event in aseptic filling:

blocks.zh: 必須停止充填，執行 Line Clearance
blocks.en: Filling must be stopped and line clearance performed

blocks.zh: 整個受影響區域需重新清潔與消毒（可能需要多次）
blocks.en: The entire affected area must be recleaned and disinfected (possibly several times)

blocks.zh: 設備需重新清洗與滅菌 (reclean + resterilize)
blocks.en: Equipment must be recleaned and resterilized

blocks.zh: 剩餘產品可能因超出 hold time 或無菌保證風險而被拒批
blocks.en: Remaining product may be rejected because hold times are exceeded or sterility assurance is at risk

blocks.zh: 商業影響：對於短保存期的生物製劑，這意味著整批報廢。這正是為何 Category 4 干預在設計充填線時就應該被工程控制消除——無菌保證永遠優先於批次救回。
blocks.en: Commercial impact: for biologics with a short shelf life, this means scrapping the entire batch. This is exactly why Category 4 interventions should be eliminated through engineering controls when the filling line is designed: sterility assurance always takes priority over salvaging a batch.

blocks.zh: 風險決策框架 Decision Framework
blocks.en: Decision Framework

blocks.zh:
機械故障發生
    ↓
Q1: 元件是否已滅菌/消毒？
    ↓ YES → Q2: 干預是否預先納入 AVS + APS？
               ↓ YES → 類別 1：執行標準干預程序
               ↓ NO  → 類別 2：即時 QA 介入 + 風險評估
    ↓ NO  → Q3: 表面是否被遮蔽（occluded）？
               ↓ YES → 類別 3：個案評估 + QA 預批准
               ↓ NO  → 類別 4（技術區域）：停止批次

決策原則：
無菌保證 > 批次救回 > 生產效率
blocks.en:
Mechanical failure occurs
    ↓
Q1: Is the component sterilized/disinfected?
    ↓ YES → Q2: Is the intervention included in advance in the AVS + APS?
               ↓ YES → Category 1: perform the standard intervention procedure
               ↓ NO  → Category 2: immediate QA involvement + risk assessment
    ↓ NO  → Q3: Is the surface occluded?
               ↓ YES → Category 3: case-by-case evaluation + QA pre-approval
               ↓ NO  → Category 4 (technical area): stop the batch

Decision principle:
Sterility assurance > batch salvage > production efficiency

blocks.zh: 一個充填機的皮帶在生產中途斷裂，更換皮帶時需要觸碰到一個平常被面板遮蔽、清潔時無法消毒的螺絲。這屬於哪個類別？你下一步怎麼做？
blocks.en: A belt on a filling machine breaks in the middle of production, and replacing it requires touching a screw that is normally hidden behind a panel and cannot be disinfected during cleaning. Which category is this? What is your next step?

blocks.zh: Category 2 的干預為什麼必須包含「隔離干預後的批次部分」？這個隔離的目的是什麼？
blocks.en: Why must a Category 2 intervention include "segregating the portion of the batch affected by the intervention"? What is the purpose of this segregation?

blocks.zh: 8.9 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Related to Environmental Monitoring 8.9 環境監測相關無菌操作之微生物學考量
blocks.en: 8.9 Microbiological Considerations for Aseptic Manipulations Related to Environmental Monitoring

blocks.zh: EM 的雙重性質：
blocks.en: The dual nature of EM:

blocks.zh: 環境監測 (Environmental Monitoring, EM) 本身是一個矛盾體——它是用來驗證環境是否無菌的工具，但執行 EM 的人員和培養基本身，就是污染環境的潛在來源。
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) is itself a paradox: it is a tool used to verify that the environment is under control, yet the personnel who perform EM and the media themselves are a potential source of contamination of the environment.

blocks.zh: 時間驅動 vs. 事件驅動：
blocks.en: Time-driven vs. event-driven:

blocks.zh: 時間驅動 (time-driven)：沉降板 (settle plates)、體積空氣采樣 (volumetric air) — 按時間間隔採集，反映整體趨勢
blocks.en: Time-driven: settle plates and volumetric air sampling, collected at time intervals and reflecting the overall trend

blocks.zh: 事件驅動 (event-driven)：接觸板 (contact plates)、棉拭 (swabs) — 對應特定事件，如干預後、人員更換班次後、批次結束後
blocks.en: Event-driven: contact plates and swabs, tied to specific events such as after an intervention, after a personnel shift change, or at the end of a batch

blocks.zh: 總顆粒監測 (total particulate) 應全程連續進行。
blocks.en: Total particulate monitoring should be performed continuously throughout.

blocks.zh: EM 樣品的全生命週期管控，就像法庭上的物證保管鏈 (chain of custody)：從採樣到判決（微生物鑑定），每一個環節都要有記錄，任何斷點都可能使結果不被採信。培養基的供應商、入庫品質管控、冷鏈保存、潔淨室操作技術、培養條件、讀板方式——每一步都必須有 SOP 和訓練記錄，否則即使培養結果正常，也無法證明這個結果是可信的。
blocks.en: Controlling the full life cycle of an EM sample is like the chain of custody for physical evidence in court: from sampling to the verdict (microbial identification), every step must be recorded, and any break may make the result inadmissible. The media supplier, incoming quality control, cold-chain storage, cleanroom handling technique, incubation conditions, and plate-reading method each need an SOP and training records; otherwise, even if the incubation result is normal, it cannot be shown to be trustworthy.

blocks.zh: 「培養基本身帶來污染風險」的監管視角：
blocks.en: The regulatory view that "the media itself poses a contamination risk":

blocks.zh: 沉降板含有促生長培養基 (growth-promoting media)，放入 Grade A 環境後：
blocks.en: Settle plates contain growth-promoting media. Once placed in the Grade A environment:

blocks.zh: 如果採樣後培養基殘留未清潔，會成為後續微生物的營養來源
blocks.en: If media residue is not cleaned up after sampling, it becomes a nutrient source for subsequent microorganisms

blocks.zh: 採樣人員本身就是最大的污染風險——EM 人員進入 Grade A 的行為本身就是一次干預，必須像其他干預一樣設計與確效
blocks.en: The sampling personnel are themselves the greatest contamination risk: an EM operator entering Grade A is itself an intervention and must be designed and qualified like any other intervention

blocks.zh: 新技術：生物螢光顆粒計數 (biofluorescent particle counting) 可以非侵入性地即時偵測活性顆粒，是傳統沉降板的潛在替代方案。EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 已開始提及此類新興技術。
blocks.en: New technology: biofluorescent particle counting can detect viable particles in real time and non-invasively, and is a potential alternative to traditional settle plates. EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) has begun to mention such emerging technologies.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 EM 程序審計中，查核人員最常問的問題包括：
blocks.en: In audits of a CDMO's EM program, the questions auditors most often ask include:

blocks.zh: 培養基的生長促進測試 (growth promotion test) 是否每批都執行？
blocks.en: Is the growth promotion test of the media performed for every lot?

blocks.zh: 掉落的沉降板如何處理？SOP 是否包含照片說明？
blocks.en: How are dropped settle plates handled? Does the SOP include photographic illustrations?

blocks.zh: 事件驅動的採樣位點（如干預後）是否與 CCS 一致？
blocks.en: Are the event-driven sampling locations (such as after an intervention) consistent with the CCS?

blocks.zh: EM 人員的技術確效記錄是否齊全？
blocks.en: Are the technique qualification records for EM personnel complete?

blocks.zh: Grade A 出現任何有活性生長的結果，應立即啟動偏差調查，保留培養板至調查完成。
blocks.en: Any growth in Grade A should immediately trigger a deviation investigation, and the plates should be retained until the investigation is complete.

blocks.zh: 一個 EM 採樣人員在採集沉降板時不小心讓板子接觸到了 Grade A 表面，然後繼續完成採樣。這個事件如何記錄和評估？採樣結果是否仍然有效？
blocks.en: While collecting a settle plate, an EM sampler accidentally lets the plate touch a Grade A surface and then continues to finish the sampling. How should this event be recorded and assessed? Is the sampling result still valid?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EM 採樣行為本身被視為「干預」？這對 APS 設計有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is the act of EM sampling itself regarded as an "intervention"? What does this mean for APS design?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (8.4–8.9)
blocks.en: Section Summary (8.4–8.9)

blocks.zh: 充填針管理 (8.4)：液體充填針的修復或更換是最高風險干預之一；預組裝流體路徑可降低更換風險；粉末充填針只能完全更換。
blocks.en: Filling needle management (8.4): repair or replacement of a liquid filling needle is one of the highest-risk interventions; a pre-assembled fluid path reduces the risk of replacement; a powder filling needle can only be replaced completely.

blocks.zh: 破損容器處置 (8.5)：所有矯正性干預必須納入 AVS 和 APS，以代表性頻率模擬；遵循「最小化行動」原則，工作高度以下的動作應避免。
blocks.en: Handling of broken containers (8.5): all corrective interventions must be included in the AVS and APS and simulated at a representative frequency; follow the "minimize actions" principle, and avoid movements below working height.

blocks.zh: 元件供應 (8.6)：自動化傳遞優先；手動傳遞必須逐層去袋，最後一層只能在 Grade A 去除；Mousehole/RTP 必須有 AVS 氣流驗證。
blocks.en: Component supply (8.6): automated transfer is preferred; manual transfer requires layer-by-layer bag removal, with the last layer removed only in Grade A; mouseholes/RTPs must have AVS airflow verification.

blocks.zh: 分選系統 (8.7)：每套 stoppering-set 個別確效；使用 Kitting 管理；矽油殘留可抑制生物去污效果，清潔時必須完全去除。
blocks.en: Sorting systems (8.7): qualify each stoppering set individually; manage with kitting; residual silicone oil can inhibit biodecontamination and must be completely removed during cleaning.

blocks.zh: 機械干預四分類 (8.8)：類別 1 標準執行；類別 2-3 需即時 QA 風險評估；類別 4（技術區域）原則上必須停止批次；無菌保證永遠優先於批次救回。
blocks.en: Four categories of mechanical intervention (8.8): Category 1 is performed as standard; Categories 2-3 need immediate QA risk assessment; Category 4 (technical area) in principle requires stopping the batch; sterility assurance always takes priority over salvaging a batch.

blocks.zh: 環境監測 (8.9)：EM 兼具「監測工具」與「污染風險」的雙重性；採樣計畫結合時間驅動與事件驅動；培養基的全生命週期需嚴格管控；EM 人員本身是最大的污染風險源。
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (8.9): EM is both a "monitoring tool" and a "contamination risk"; the sampling plan combines time-driven and event-driven sampling; the full life cycle of the media must be tightly controlled; EM personnel are themselves the greatest source of contamination risk.
